scientific_limitations_and_integrity.known_inputs: The all-n two-vertex moment identity, distance density, and spindle area formula are established in arxiv:2608.29975v1; the integral and n=3,4 cases are not new.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Not uniform across arbitrary joint radius/sample sequences, higher dimensions or other source bodies; independent scientific validation not performed; publication priority provisional.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: An explicit polynomial critical asymptotic with two terms, a sharp fixed-supercritical exponential asymptotic, and an n^-2 critical window with explicit monotone crossover.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Uniform area samples in a Euclidean unit disc, radius-R ball-convex hull, R>=1, exactly two extreme points; n->infinity at fixed R, at R=1 or R=1+kappa/n^2 for fixed kappa>=0.

title: A critical-window law for the two-vertex event in random disc-polygons
